recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Future Condition.evidence work should preserve the CodeableReference shape unless Patient Care makes a new model decision, while also respecting the later FHIR-32755 binding and FHIR-42981 causality clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-32481 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked what relationship was intended between Condition.evidence.code and Condition.evidence.detail combinations and resolved to change Condition.evidence to 0..* CodeableReference, delete con-2, delete code/detail, and include an example in the comments.
initial_application: The issue was applied by 64575fff1553ef5387b7693c678a205ea7f34e6c (J#32481) and merged through HL7/fhir#1643. That change replaced the BackboneElement evidence/code/detail grouping with CodeableReference targeting Resource, removed the old con-2 invariant, and added a concept/reference example in the element comment.
additional_context: Condition is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current source keeps Condition.evidence as CodeableReference, retains the example explaining separate concept and reference entries, and no longer defines Condition.evidence.code or Condition.evidence.detail. The Condition search parameters now target Condition.evidence.concept and Condition.evidence.reference. FHIR-32755 later changed the evidence concept binding, and FHIR-42981 later clarified the evidence definition and causality guidance; both are already separately represented on the combined branch and do not reverse the FHIR-32481 structure. Patient Care minutes for 2021-12-02 list FHIR-32481 among discussed Jira items, matching the Jira vote context, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because the active Condition source already implements the requested CodeableReference structure, deleted invariant, removed code/detail backbone elements, and requested example comment.
